Package details
Sim price is 100 taka
Start-up bonus:
After activation, the customer will get 60 minutes talk time, 60 SMS, 5 GB data (validity for 30 days) on the first recharge of Tk 99.
Special data offer:
Oporajita customers can enjoy 1GB data after SIM activation as many times as they want in three months for taka.9. validity 7 days.
Unused data will not be added later.
The recharge amount is inclusive of VAT, SD and surcharges.
Conditions:
Only women customers can purchase and migrate the Oporajita package.
To migrate to Oporajita package contact nearest customer care.
Special data packs are valid for 3 months from the date of package activation.
FnF activation procedure:
To set FnF number
Dial 1515 and follow the next direction or write Reg in message option and send it to 363.
To add FnF
After getting a confirmation SMS to add a FNF number – Write Add in message option then put a space then write the desired FnF number and send to 363.
For Example: Add 0155XXXXXXXX and send to 363
To set every FnF number you have to send individual message by following the same procedure but have to register only once.
It will be activated within 72 hours.
To Delete FnF
Write del in message option then put a space then write the desired FnF number and send to 363.
For Example: del 0155XXXXXXXX and send to 363.
To Check FnF
Write see in message option and send to 363.
For Example: see 0155XXXXXXXX and send to 363.
Change FnF
Dial 1515 and follow the next direction.
